Hi Alex / Priya / Michael,

Thanks again for the call earlier - really appreciated the time and context. Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for customer-facing chat + embeddings for search/rerank.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p95 for short queries, E2E data isolation for PII, and predictable unit economics (cost per 1k tokens).
- Stakeholders: Product (Alex), Security/Compliance (Priya), Engineering (Michael).

Next step: 30-min demo (intro to Redwood + how we'd fit into your infra) - goal is to show runtime performance, deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), and a short Q&A. Can you pick one of these 30-minute slots?

Option A: Thu Mar 12 - 9:00-9:30 AM PST
Option B: Mon Mar 15 - 10:00-10:30 AM PST
Option C: Wed Mar 17 - 2:00-2:30 PM PST

If none of those work, send 2-3 alternative windows and we'll accommodate. Also please confirm who from your side will join so we can tailor the demo (e.g., want security to see the private deployment and KMS/HSM notes?).

Attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (brief run of show). I've also attached a high-level MVP pricing sheet for context - will follow up with more detailed TCO if helpful.

Camila (cc'd) will send the invite once we lock a time.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
